timelineEvents.label: 22 June 1934 · Montpellier festival programme
timelineEvents.shortDescription: A Montpellier summer-festival programme documented “Ninon, quand tu me souris” beyond the cinema.
timelineEvents.longDescription: A programme published on 22 June 1934 listed a jazz orchestra performing “Ninon, quand tu me souris” from Tout pour l’amour on an open-air stage at a summer festival in Montpellier.
